case_title: Rajput Jabbarsingh Malaji v. State of Gujarat
trial_court_outcome: Convicted of murder and sentenced to life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The accused, who was related to the victim, was involved in an incident where the victim sustained severe facial injuries from an axe, leading to his death. The victim's wife, who was sleeping nearby, witnessed the attack and raised an alarm. The victim was taken to the hospital where he was declared dead. The accused's blood-stained scarf and axe were recovered and tested, showing a match with the victim's blood type. The prosecution's case was corroborated by multiple witnesses and forensic evidence, establishing the accused's involvement in the fatal incident.
